sample_unit: clinician evaluations of model outputs (500 cardiac surgery cases x 4 models)

links.outcome: Clinician trust ratings of four candidate LLMs on the same 500 cardiac surgery cases
links.effect: GPT-5 mean 4.83 and Claude 3.5 Opus 4.79 (each >98% high-trust); Sonnet 3.9 (74%); Haiku 3.6 (66%). Side-by-side comparison exposed clear differences between candidate models.
links.quote: Claude 3.5 Sonnet performed moderately (mean 3.9, 74% high-trust), while Claude 3.5 Haiku produced less context-specific recommendations (mean 3.6, 66% high-trust).

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates LLM-generated intraoperative guidance and postoperative decision support (CardiacGPT) using clinician ratings of trust and relevance across different foundation models.
